comment: The International Patient Summary may be treated as the minimum LHR dataset. IPS is a specific cross-border and unscheduled-care summary and does not define the complete longitudinal record.

public.text: The International Patient Summary may be treated as the minimum LHR dataset. IPS is a specific cross-border and unscheduled-care summary and does not define the complete longitudinal record.
public.suggestedRevision: Present IPS as one priority summary use case and exchange artefact rather than the universal minimum content model for the LHR.
